name: chart-reactions
title: Chart Reactions
description: Shared configurable meme loading and explicit metric emotions with reduced-motion-safe poster and text fallbacks.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Show shared loading feedback even without configured assets

props.name: reaction
props.description: Optional explicit emotion or metric { current, previous, goal, lowerIsBetter }, resolver, assets, and enabled flag

props.name: assets
props.description: Provider asset mapping: optional src, alt, and static poster. No default requests

props.name: animationsEnabled
props.description: Provider animation control; reduced motion always takes priority

ai.purpose: Provide opt-in data emotions and accessible loading without guessing categorical meaning or asset URLs.
avoid: Inferring emotion from arbitrary chart data
